messages:
Jo (Design): tossing a new sketch into the thread: Spend table with an inline "token stack" that flips to show fiat on hover. Invoice CTA is moved to a persistent mini-toolbar next to the scope selector. Fig link in thread.
Nikhil (PM): high level: finance teams asked for invoice to be obvious. moving it next to scope seems fine if keyboard + mobile are covered.
Tess (FE): front-end notes: hover-to-show fiat is nice, but mobile needs a tap state. propose tap toggles the pill. Also we should avoid extra API calls on initial render.
Marco (Eng): backend: we can include fiat in initial payload for current page; for big table loads we'll lazy-load. we can add ?show_fiat=compact to avoid blowups.
Rita (Content): CTA copy candidates: "Download invoice (PDF/CSV)" vs "Export invoice". prefer explicit "Download invoice (PDF/CSV)". aria-label: "Download billing invoice for selected scope and period".
a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure focus order is logical — scope toggle -> invoice button -> table filter. Use aria-pressed for toggle states.
Jo (Design): visual tweak: add a faint vertical divider between sparkline and token stack so eye can separate visual from numbers. also increase token number contrast.
Tess (FE): keyboard flow: invoice button must be two tabs from scope toggle. Also support Enter/Space to open export menu.
Marco (Eng): perf note: sticky mini-toolbar across long scrolls will cause paint if there are many pinned elements. Suggest virtualize rows and only apply position:sticky to the toolbar container.
Nikhil (PM): acceptance criteria for the sprint: (1) persistent invoice control next to scope (desktop) and in header (mobile); (2) reachable within two tab stops; (3) aria-label present; (4) no extra full-page payloads for fiat unless opted-in.
Jo (Design): Ill update the mock with divider + hover/tap state and add mobile header variant.
Rita (Content): Ill finalize button copy and add tooltip text: "Includes cached tokens and prefix reuse".
Tess (FE): Ill prototype TokenPill(toggleOnTap=true) and keyboard order.
Marco (Eng): Ill add a proposal for show_fiat query flag and check DB load.
a11y-bot: Note: add aria-live region for scope changes so screenreaders announce the new totals.
Jo (Design): cool. adding to Figma and will ping when ready. :sparkles:
Nikhil (PM): thanks all — tagging follow-up in next standup.
